title: HSA limits for 2026 and the new bronze plan rule
label: Year-end tax move

hook.sub: Plus a new rule for bronze plans.

beats.sub: They now work with an HSA.
The tax filing deadline, without extensions.

items.t: See how much is in for 2026

cta.sub: We'll DM you our year-end planning page.

captions.instagram:
Have a health savings account? Here are the 2026 numbers.

✔️ Contribution limits: $4,400 for self-only coverage, $8,750 for family coverage, plus $1,000 more if you're 55 or older.
✔️ New for 2026: bronze and catastrophic health plans are treated as HSA-eligible.
✔️ You can still contribute for 2026 until April 15, 2027.
✔️ Check your plan, see what's already in for 2026, and keep your medical receipts.

More year-end moves on our year-end planning page.

sources.fact: 2026 HSA limits $4,400 self-only / $8,750 family, +$1,000 at 55+; bronze and catastrophic plans are treated as HDHPs; 2026 contributions allowed until April 15, 2027 (2026 Form 8889 instructions, draft); read 2026-10-30

OBBB provisions: bronze and catastrophic plans HSA-compatible from Jan. 1, 2026; non-itemizers may deduct up to $1,000 ($2,000 MFJ) of cash gifts to charity from tax year 2026, donor-advised funds and supporting organizations excluded; read 2026-10-30
